newsitem.title: USA: Brazil 97/98 coffee estimate too low -USDA analyst.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 97/98 coffee estimate too low -USDA analyst.

text.p: A recent estimate that pegged Brazil's 1997/98 coffee crop at 17.3 million 60-kg bags was premature and will likely prove to be too low, a U.S. Department of Agriculture analyst said.
"The facts would seem not to support an unusually low crop in the area of 17 million next year," said Ed Missiaen, specialty crops analyst at the USDA.
"The winter was not too dry or too cold. Given what we know about the weather, the trees should be coming into the blooming period in good shape," he added.
